title: Literal Lock-In: How Test Language Shifts Literal Attraction in Typed Decision Models on Bengali Idioms
abstract: arXiv:2610.22526v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision models, non-generative scorers that report a probability over caller-supplied options and emit no text, are increasingly deployed as routers, classifiers and guardrails. Because they generate nothing, rationales and chain-of-thought do not apply. We audit three: an encoder scorer, a decoder scorer and a closed API, entirely through interventions on their input, using expert-annotated Bengali idioms carrying a gold figurative and a gold literal gloss. Dropping an idiom's own literal gloss into the option list draws every arm toward it, taking 65% to 96% of each arm's remaining Bengali errors. A model-by-language matrix over one shared item set shows how far this depends on the test language: every arm is 1.9 to 6.4 times more captured in Bengali than in English on the same paired entries, the commercial model's apparent resistance is a property of its test language, and capability does not order the failure. Calibration degrades

translated_title: 字面锁定：测试语言如何改变类型化决策模型对孟加拉语习语的字面吸引
translated_abstract: 决策模型，即对调用方提供的选项输出概率且不生成任何文本的非生成式评分器，正日益被部署为路由器、分类器和安全护栏。由于它们不生成任何内容，推理依据和思维链等方法并不适用。我们通过对三个模型（一个编码器评分器、一个解码器评分器和一个闭源API）的输入进行干预来审计它们，使用的是专家标注的孟加拉语习语，每个习语都带有黄金比喻义释义和黄金字面义释义。将习语自身的字面义释义放入选项列表中，会把每个选项的输出都拉向它，占每个选项剩余孟加拉语错误的65%至96%。在共享的同一项目集上构建的模型-语言矩阵揭示了这种现象在多大程度上取决于测试语言：在相同的配对条目上，每个模型在孟加拉语中被字面义捕获的程度是英语中的1.9至6.4倍，商业模型表面上的抵抗性其实是其测试语言的属性，而模型能力并不能预测这种失败的排序。校准性能退化（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现，将字面义释义混入选项列表会强烈吸引各类非生成式决策模型（占其剩余孟加拉语错误的65%至96%），且这种“字面锁定”效应在孟加拉语中比英语强1.9至6.4倍，表明此类失败主要取决于测试语言而非模型能力。
en_tdlr: Inserting a literal gloss into the option list strongly captures non-generative decision models on Bengali idioms (accounting for 65–96% of remaining errors), and this "literal lock-in" effect is 1.9 to 6.4 times stronger in Bengali than in English, showing the failure depends on the test language rather than model capability.
